displayName: AdKit for TikTok Ads: Campaigns, Ad Groups, Video Ads, Spark Ads and Reporting
description: Create, edit, and report on TikTok ads from an AI agent through the AdKit MCP connector: campaigns, ad groups, video ads, Spark Ads, media upload, and results. Every change is saved as a draft that the user approves before it goes live. Use when the user wants to run, change, or check TikTok ads. Not for TikTok ad strategy or creative advice.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
